scope: White groups can actively request all business tools; gray groups can use basic chat and fixed conversions only

policy.paired_owner: All business tools and existing private administrative commands
policy.white_group: All business tools on a user-initiated prefixed request, including the configured DeepSeek account balance and Xueyuanlu classroom / Building 3 briefing
policy.gray_group: Basic chat and fixed conversions only: HU$/CNY, Mali/distance, Mashi/time, marathon and half-marathon
policy.administration: Authenticated local console; group text and model arguments cannot change membership or recipients
policy.automatic_notifications: Existing owner-only schedules unchanged; explicitly authorized broadcasts enumerate owner and white groups only

implementation.ui_section: 04: bind to selected tier, switch tier, remove
implementation.trusted_tier: Generated by BridgeCore from persisted membership; never inferred from group messages
implementation.langchain: Python tool binding and direct execution respect the trusted tier; gray conversions reuse the fixed tool without requiring a model
implementation.node_guards: RPC execution, result projection and final send check access; media sends check again after upload
implementation.revocation: Downgrade/removal restrict pending delivery immediately and clear group background; messages already submitted to QQ cannot be recalled
implementation.balance_privacy: Value is delivered directly, never sent to the model for explanation, and replaced by a fixed placeholder in group background
implementation.legacy_state: Existing allowedGroups remain white; missing grayGroups becomes an empty list; cross-list duplicates and malformed entries fail closed
implementation.legacy_error_code: CAMPUS_OWNER_ONLY retained for compatibility; trusted white groups are now permitted

tests.model_routing: Real LangChain graph with scripted offline model responses; no online model calls
tests.sdk: Real adapter exercised with mocked official SDK transport, including downgrade during upload

deployment.restart_method: Managed identity-checked stop; existing background scheduler restarted the service before the explicit start check

not_live_tested: Natural-language selection by the online model
Actual group QQ delivery of balance or Building 3 results
repository: Private GitHub repository; no credentials, live state, group IDs or query artifacts included
